integrity.common_zero_basis: An ordered tuple of \(n\) monomials in \(n\) variables has no common projective zero exactly when it consists of one pure power of each variable, hence is indexed by a permutation.
integrity.euler_basis: Compactly supported Euler characteristic localizes to the fixed locus for algebraic \(\mathbb C^*\)-actions; additivity then gives the projective resultant-locus formula.
integrity.fixed_point_basis: A base-weight diagonal one-parameter subgroup has monomials as the only fixed coefficient points in each factor.
integrity.object_basis: The archival source defines the Macaulay resultant for \(n\) homogeneous forms in \(n\) variables and characterizes its vanishing by a common projective root.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The published archival source lists MSC 14N99 first, with 13P99 and 13D25 also listed.

scientific_limitations: The theorem computes Euler characteristic only; it does not determine homotopy type, Betti numbers, mixed Hodge structure, singularities, or resultant degree.
The statement concerns independently projectivized coefficient blocks and the genuinely multivariate regime \(n\ge3\).
The localization proof is short, so an older unindexed or folklore observation may exist.
title: The genuinely multivariate resultant complement has degree-independent Euler characteristic
